$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Community-Spec-1.0. FPSOT decisions event data (DEC-072). The data holds identifiers and codes only, never the value of a fact, an amount or a name (DEC-044). The CloudEvents attributes follow API-101.
title: org.fpsot.decisions.notice.issued
description: A body issued a notice about a decision (DEC-056, DEC-072).

noticeId.description: The id of the notice record, which is also the id of this event (DEC-041).

decisionId.description: The decision record that the notice communicates (DEC-056).

templateId.description: The template that rendered the notice (DEC-056).

channel.description: How the body sent the notice (DEC-056).

automationNotice.description: Whether the notice stated that automation took part (DEC-057).

recourseChannels.description: Each recourse or observations channel that the notice offered (DEC-057).

sealedRecordId.description: The id of the seal manifest of the rendered notice (LOG-019).
